test_run_tests: test the run_tests function that conditionally runs torch dynamo tests with optional dependency checks
create_testcase_class: create a torch dynamo TestCase class that patches config, resets counters, and tracks grad mode across tests
run_tests_with_cuda: run tests with cuda dependency check that skips if cuda is unavailable
run_tests_with_module: run tests with module dependency check that skips if import fails
test_testcase_setup_teardown: test the TestCase setUp and tearDown methods that reset counters and restore grad mode
